what_it_does: This paper presents a novel data transmission scheme for 3D stacked integrated circuits (vertically stacked computer chips connected through multiple layers). The key innovation is a tri-level signaling method using inductive coupling (magnetic coils for wireless power/signal transfer between layers) to transmit data across chip boundaries. The differential signaling approach improves the signal quality by a factor of five, allowing the same amount of data to be transmitted with higher reliability or using fewer transmission pins on the package.
